segments.an4.61:1.1: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an4.61:2.1: “Cattārome, gahapati, dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:2.3: Bhogā me uppajjantu sahadhammenāti, ayaṃ paṭhamo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:3.1: “Bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yaso me āgacchatu saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehīti, ayaṃ dutiyo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:4.1: “Bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yasaṃ laddhā saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehi ciraṃ jīvāmi dīghamāyuṃ pālemīti, ayaṃ tatiyo dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:5.1: “Bhoge laddhā sahadhammena yasaṃ laddhā saha ñātīhi saha upajjhāyehi ciraṃ jīvitvā dīghamāyuṃ pāletvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjāmīti, ayaṃ catuttho dhammo iṭṭho kanto manāpo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:5.2: Ime kho, gahapati, cattāro dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā dullabhā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.61:6.1: “Imesaṃ kho, gahapati, catunnaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ cattāro dhammā paṭilābhāya saṃvattanti.
segments.an4.61:7.2: Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ –
segments.an4.61:7.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi, satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an4.61:8.2: Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti … pe … surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
segments.an4.61:9.2: Idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vosaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
segments.an4.61:10.2: Abhijjhāvisamalobhābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti.
segments.an4.61:10.3: Akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
segments.an4.61:10.4: Byāpādābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti.
segments.an4.61:10.5: Akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
segments.an4.61:10.6: Thinamiddhābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti kiccaṃ aparādheti.
segments.an4.61:10.7: Akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
segments.an4.61:10.8: Uddhaccakukkuccābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti.
segments.an4.61:10.9: Akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
segments.an4.61:10.10: Vicikicchābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti.
segments.an4.61:10.11: Akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.
segments.an4.61:11.1: “Sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
segments.an4.61:11.2: Byāpādo cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā byāpādaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
segments.an4.61:11.3: Thinamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā thinamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
segments.an4.61:11.4: Uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
segments.an4.61:11.5: Vicikicchā cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā vicikicchaṃ cittassa upakkilesaṃ pajahati.
segments.an4.61:12.1: “Yato ca kho, gahapati, ariyasāvakassa abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā abhijjhāvisamalobho cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti.
segments.an4.61:12.2: Byāpādo cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā byāpādo cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti.
segments.an4.61:12.3: Thinamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā thinamiddhaṃ cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti.
segments.an4.61:12.4: Uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā uddhaccakukkuccaṃ cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti.
segments.an4.61:12.5: Vicikicchā cittassa upakkilesoti, iti viditvā vicikicchā cittassa upakkileso pahīno hoti.
segments.an4.61:12.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, gahapati, ariyasāvako mahāpañño puthupañño āpātadaso [āpāthadaso (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paññāsampanno [hāsapañño (ka.)].
segments.an4.61:12.8: Imesaṃ kho, gahapati, catunnaṃ dhammānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ dullabhānaṃ lokasmiṃ ime cattāro dhammā paṭilābhāya saṃvattanti.
segments.an4.61:13.1: “Sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi cattāri pattakammāni kattā hoti.
segments.an4.61:13.3: Idha gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati.
segments.an4.61:13.4: Mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati.
segments.an4.61:13.5: Puttadāradāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati.
segments.an4.61:13.6: Mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti sammā sukhaṃ pariharati.
segments.an4.61:13.7: Idamassa paṭhamaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
segments.an4.61:14.1: “Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi yā tā honti āpadā aggito vā udakato vā rājato vā corato vā appiyato vā dāyādato [a. ni.5.41], tathārūpāsu āpadāsu pariyodhāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.61:14.3: Idamassa dutiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
segments.an4.61:15.1: “Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti –
segments.an4.61:15.3: Idamassa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
segments.an4.61:16.1: “Puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā madappamādā paṭiviratā khantisoracce niviṭṭhā ekamattānaṃ damenti, ekamattānaṃ samenti, ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpenti, tathārūpesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
segments.an4.61:16.2: Idamassa catutthaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
segments.an4.61:17.1: “Sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi imāni cattāri pattakammāni kattā hoti.
segments.an4.61:17.2: Yassa kassaci, gahapati, aññatra imehi catūhi pattakammehi bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ime vuccanti, gahapati, bhogā aṭṭhānagatā apattagatā anāyatanaso paribhuttā.
segments.an4.61:17.3: Yassa kassaci, gahapati, imehi catūhi pattakammehi bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ime vuccanti, gahapati, bhogā ṭhānagatā pattagatā āyatanaso paribhuttā”ti.
segments.an4.61:18.1: “Bhuttā bhogā bhatā bhaccā [gatā bhūtā (ka.) bhaṭā bhaccā (syā. kaṃ.)],

lines: Sahadhammenāti dhammeneva saddhiṃ uppajjantu, mā dhammūpaghātaṃ katvā adhammenāti.
Athavā sahadhammenāti sakāraṇena, tena tena senāpatiseṭṭhiṭṭhānādikāraṇena saddhiṃyeva uppajjantūti attho.
Saha upajjhāyehīti sukhadukkhesu upanijjhāyitabbattā upajjhāyasaṅkhātehi sandiṭṭhasambhattehi saddhiṃ.
Kiccaṃ aparādhetīti kattabbayuttakaṃ kiccaṃ akaronto taṃ aparādheti nāma.
Āpātadasoti taṃ taṃ atthaṃ āpāteti tameva passati, sukhumampissa atthajātaṃ āpātaṃ āgacchatiyevāti attho.
Sedāvakkhittehīti avakkhittasedehi, sedaṃ muñcitvā vāyāmena payogena samadhigatehīti attho.
Catūsu pattakammesu ekaṃ bhogehi kattabbakammaṃ bhogajātameva ṭhānagataṃ.
Yathā aggiādīhi uppannāsu āpadāsu, evaṃ ādittagehanibbāpanādīnaṃ atthāya dhanapariccāgaṃ katvā tāsaṃ āpadānaṃ maggaṃ pidahati nivāreti.
Sotthiṃ attānaṃ karotīti nirupaddavaṃ khemaṃ attānaṃ karoti.
Sabbametaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ yathānucchavikavasena dātabbadānassa adhivacanaṃ.
Ekamattānaṃ damentīti ekaṃ attanova attabhāvaṃ indriyadamena damenti.
Suṭṭhu aggānaṃ dibbavaṇṇādīnaṃ dasannaṃ visesānaṃ nibbattanato saggasaṃvattanikā, evarūpaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpetīti attho.
Pecca sagge pamodatīti paralokaṃ gantvā yattha sagge paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhāti, tattha modati.
Sotāpannasakadāgāmino vā hontu anāgāmī vā, sabbesaṃ ayaṃ paṭipadā labbhatevāti.
61-64. Dutiyassa paṭhame ye aniṭṭhā na honti, te iṭṭhāti adhippetāti āha “aniṭṭhapaṭikkhepena iṭṭhā”ti.
Iṭṭhāti ca pariyiṭṭhā vā hotu mā vā, iṭṭhārammaṇabhūtāti attho.
Gavesitampi hi iṭṭhanti vuccati, taṃ idha nādhippetaṃ.
Upanijjhāyīyantīti upajjhāyāti āha “sukhadukkhesu upanijjhāyitabbattā”ti, sukhadukkhesu uppannesu anussaritabbattāti attho.
Sandiṭṭhasambhattehīti ettha tattha tattha saṅgamma diṭṭhamattā nātidaḷhamittā sandiṭṭhā, suṭṭhu bhattā sinehavanto daḷhamittā sambhattā.
Tathābhūto pana yasmā balasampanno hoti, tasmā “balasampannaṃ karotī”ti vuttaṃ.
Sobhane kāyikavācasikakamme ratoti sūrato ukārassa dīghaṃ katvā, tassa bhāvo soraccaṃ, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo.
So pana atthato susīlabhāvoti āha “khantisoracce niviṭṭhāti adhivāsanakkhantiyañca susīlatāya ca niviṭṭhā”ti.
Rāgādīnañhi pubbabhāgiyaṃ damanādi paccekaṃ icchitabbaṃ, na maggakkhaṇe viya ekajjhaṃ paṭisaṅkhānamukhena pajahanato.
Vaṇṇaggahaṇena cettha sako attabhāvavaṇṇo gahito, rūpaggahaṇena bahiddhā rūpārammaṇaṃ.
